quotes.title: Kepler-17
quotes.card: Kepler-17 is a main-sequence yellow dwarf star about 2,310 light-years away in the constellation Cygnus.
quotes.introduction: It is much more active than the Sun, with starspots covering roughly 6% of its surface.
